issue_context.title: Wrong syntax highligting with `systemctl cat` for multiline value
issue_context.body:
### systemd version the issue has been seen with

256.9-2.fc41

### Used distribution

Fedora 41

### Linux kernel version used

6.12.4-200.fc41

### CPU architectures issue was seen on

x86_64

### Component

systemctl

### Expected behaviour you didn't see

`systemctl cat` should correctly syntax highlight service files

### Unexpected behaviour you saw

Multiline values which contain an equal sign are colored green up to the equal sign even though they are just part of a larger string.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/63764320-88e8-4719-aa8c-5e253f7d62d1)


### Steps to reproduce the problem

Create a service containing the below content and run `systemctl cat` on in.

```ini
Environment="ARGS= \
    --collector.cpu.info \
    --collector.drm \
    --collector.ethtool \
    --collector.systemd \
    --collector.systemd.unit-include=(ds-player-backend|kiosksession@tty1)\\.service \
    --collector.systemd.enable-restarts-metrics \
    --collector.systemd.enable-start-time-metrics \
"
```

### Additional program output to the terminal or log subsystem illustrating the issue

_No response_
